<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    function moveLogoToBottom() {
      var sidebar = document.getElementById('quarto-sidebar');
      if (!sidebar) {
        return;
      }
      var logoLink = sidebar.querySelector('.sidebar-logo-link');
      if (!logoLink) {
        return;
      }
      sidebar.appendChild(logoLink);
    }

    moveLogoToBottom();
  });
</script>
